name: vibeseo-ai-seo
description: An AI SEO (GEO) workflow for the VibeSEO AEO/GEO connector: the sources AI answers cite, gap pages that mention competitors but not you, and a plan for getting cited.

interface.longDescription:
Find out which sites and pages AI answer engines cite when they answer your customers' questions, which of those pages mention your competitors but not you, and which of your own pages already get cited. The result is a short plan for getting cited more: where to get mentioned, what to publish, and which of your pages to strengthen, each backed by the sources AI answers actually use.

Requires the VibeSEO AEO/GEO connector ("AEO/GEO by VibeSEO"): add it in one tap at https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6aaf8722e298819196ae5a92ad4a52fe and sign in. You also need a VibeSEO project with AI visibility tracking set up.
defaultPrompt: Which sites do AI answers cite for questions in my market?
Which pages mention my competitors but not us in AI answers?
What should we publish to get cited in AI answers?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: a guided AI SEO plan over the VibeSEO AEO/GEO connector.
